reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with this plumbing company! The two technicians who came out were incredibly professional and knew exactly what the issue was within the first minute of being here. From the moment they arrived to the moment they left, it was maybe 30 minutes total — fast, efficient, and no wasted time. They fixed the problem quickly and even put me at ease by explaining the guarantee on their work. I definitely plan on using them again if I ever need to, and I’ll be recommending them

Mario performed my annual heater checkup and did an outstanding job.  He was professional, efficient & explained everything in "layman's" terms.  He even swept up my attic (I'd recently had a new roof put on) and this attic is not easy to access!  I really appreciate his thoroughness and attention to detail - will definitely ask for him next time!

We had a clog in line and they came out same day. We initially contacted OneGuard home warranty but they sent a 2 star rating plumber. Called Milestone, The tech was great. He took his time. I could tell he genuinely wanted to get us taken care of. First time we called them. So glad we did.

Jesus was so professional, knowledgeable & friendly. He answered all the questions I had for him regarding replacing my water heater. He prepared three quote options for my review & he worked hard to get me any available discounts.
He explained to me details of the Milestone Advantage Plan program.
He was so organized & meticulous in his work. I hardly knew he was there!
I couldn’t be any happier with my decision to go with Milestone! Milestone should be very proud to have an employee like Jesus

Roberto went above and beyond in his efforts to diagnose and remedy our plumbing issue. Roberto was very thorough in his work and his integrity  and professionalism were evident in his demeanor and interactions with us. He put out a great amount of effort that shows he cares about what he is doing and about helping us as customers. We appreciate  what he did and wish him future success.  Lance Higgins

Bryan was courteous and professional. He completed a thorough evaluation of the electrical work I requested. He listened to my input and answered all my questions. He was knowledgeable and informative. Definitely a professional!

Austin spent three hours with me, educating me, and explaining to me all the details that were important for both of us regarding my new AC purchase. I learned more than I can retain, but I trust in him as I also trust Milestone 100%. What I have learned is important for me to know as well as his need to educate me. I recommend Milestone 100%. There is so much more I can share on this post. As a consumer needing information and understanding all the details and needing to trust, my needs are sec

Zaul was great. Very professional and knowledgeable. He was incredibly kind and very patiently answered my questions. He went above and beyond to do all he could to make the situation fixable. Would definitely recommend!

If you want professional guaranteed work call milestone. It’s always best to have a professional do important work such as electrical.  They came out and installed two new garage light fixture outlets and installed an electrical box before installing a new chandelier. They were on time and did a very good clean up before they left. Work looks amazing!!!!!

Service technician was on time and completed several tasks, including installation of ceiling fans, in a timely manner. In addition to the tasks he was asked to do, he addressed a few other issues, which were resolved at no extra cost. He was very courteous and friendly. I would recommend milestone electric for all electrical needs.

Mario Castro went above and beyond today as he braved an extremely low ceiling in my attic to properly examine my system.  The video he made showed me the things that I might need to address for my air quality and result's to keep my system running it's best.

Thank You Mario, it was an awesome experience getting to know you!

Hugo was so kind and professional.  He worked overtime to get our HVAC running so we could be comfortable.  And he helped me set up the app to control our thermostat from my phone.  I’m grateful for his help!

We had our circuit breaker box replaced, new circuit breakers installed & aluminum wire replaced with copper and our home brought up to code. We showed them around and answered questions then left for the week. When we came back everything was done and in good working order. We are happy with the service.

Andrew Guardiola did an outstanding job. I’ve used Milestone about 5 times now for various things and I’ve never had a poor experience. In fact, I’ve always been blown away by the level of professionalism. One happy customer here!

Our furnace was tripping off when it came on. We called Milestone and Cristian came out and assessed the situation. Cristian was very professional, interacted with our dogs, and was a very nice young man. He set up another appointment the next day for another Milestone professional to see about fixing the furnace issues. Milestone has taken care of our needs now for about three years.
Benny Wu was outstanding. He was sincere and authentic in his approach. The level of customer service he provided was exceptional, and I wholeheartedly recommend him.

Daniel was a fresh ray of sunshine both professionally and personally. My husband and I were both very pleased with him. His problem solving solutions led to an HVAC system update to solve the cause of the drain clog issues. The price sounds high but it includes the addition of a pump for the HVAC system as well.
Christian P. came out and did an outstanding job. He was polite and very professional. He explained everything that was done, and his work was excellent. So glad we chose Milestone!

Mathew completed the install of two ceiling fans w one being defective on trial.  Explained & showed factory alignment error, patiently disassembled & boxed for return.  We reordered & he will return in a few days to hopefully complete two fan install.  He is indeed a proficient employee.  We do appreciate his patience & ability to protect us from defective product.  He gets an A+ from our home project!

Zachariah did a superb job today.  His skills are exceptional.  He pre prepared exactly what he needed and got it right the first time.  Fantastic work and a job well done. Highly Zachariah and Milestone

Jacob was very polite and professional.  Explain clearly about the possible issues. Once problem was identified,  he explained the options to me and husband. Provided all options in writing.  We will be calling to use services again. Very pleased with services given

Mason was clear about when he would arrive, which was much appreciated. It was 64 degrees in the house. He fixed the problem, got the heat working, and showed me a video of the HVAC work he did in the attic. He was pleasant and I will ask for him again when work needs to be done.    Thank you Mason!

I had an extremely disappointing and frustrating experience with Milestone Electric recently. The quality of work was absolutely unacceptable. After their technician left, we discovered that the air conditioning unit in our attic had been left completely open, with wires cut and exposed. No one informed us of this condition before they left, and we only found it the next day when a technician from a different company came for a second opinion. This is not just unprofessional—it's dangerous. On t

The appointment was very informative. Joshua explained everything that needed to be done and made sure I understood everything which I really appreciated. It was an enjoyable visit and Joshua was very patient with the questions

Benjamin did an excellent  job in our toilet issues. He was very knowledgeable, easy to speak to and answered others Mechanical/Electrical/Plumbing questions I had about our home. Thank you Benjamin and the Milestone team! Martin & Cathy
Easy to talk to and explained what the issues was very knowledgeable and worked with our budget. Our family highly recommends Milestone for you home needs. Great people work there 😀
Florencio was very knowledgeable on the work he performed. My system came back on and was working in about 20 minutes. He even checked my filter and replaced it with a new one. Good work Florencio!

Our upstairs unit was not producing cold air to the rooms it serves. Our technician (Hugo) spent a considerable amount of time diagnosing the issue without any grumbling or complaints. Once he found the problem, he quickly went to work to install new wiring and reconnect it to the unit. He ensured he had all of the proper readings and the unit was producing the temperatures that we were looking for from our unit. He cleaned up his work area and reinspected everything before departing. We couldn'

Johnathan went above and beyond with my plumbing needs. I highly recommend Milestone Home Service. Become a member and the perks pay for them selves.
Update:  Just had Ricardo out to repair an emergency water issue. He replaced the line going to my fridge. What an awesome job he did. I highly recommend Ricardo.

Austin was very professional, methodical and willing to answer all my questions prior to start. He did the install just the same, professional, methodical and in a timely fashion. Cleaned up just as he found it. KUDOS!

Chase was great. I needed him to install a bidet for a family member following surgery which rendered her unable to perform necessary cleaning functions. I already had the bidet, so the installation price seemed rather high, but it had to be done.

I  am pleased with the service provided by Mario Castro. He conducted a meticulous inspection of my HVAC system. He is very knowledgeable and explained things to me in a way that made me understand what needed to be done on my system to keep it working smoothly. Mario is very professional in what he does, and the most important thing is that I value his honesty. I recommend him 100% to any customer :)

Armando would get 10 stars if I could. He is a kind, communicative, and thorough person. Would have him back in a heartbeat!

Dropping one star because we had a bit of an issue with scheduling. The dispatch was unclear and gave inaccurate information.

We had three companies out for a water heater quote. But I couldn't be home. Christian from Milestone was the only one who was detail oriented enough to notice that the power box wasn't where my brother thought it was. I was really impressed.
Ignacio did a great job figuring what was wrong. He also was able to explain everything to me. Work well done!
Sebastion was very good today but came to service my heater to get ready for winter. His attention to details and correspondence with me was impressive  Always a huge fan of Milestone

Dewyane was wonderful! A true miracle worker! We've had a continuous problem with a massive leak from upstairs through the floor into our laundry room. We've had several specialists and they've only provided a tempoary solution. Dwayne said that he was going to find a permanent solution and then showed us how to avoid future problems. He rerouted the pipes and we're confident that the wet floors and leaks are now only a bad memory.

Steven and his crew did a wonderful job for me today. They went above and beyond what I expected. They worked quietly and efficiently. Each step was explained carefully and they insured that I understood what was being done. They tested everything out thoroughly before they left. Very satisfied customer!

Our AC tech Dustin was very knowledgeable, professional and detail oriented. Explained all the issues and recommended solutions without high pressure sales. We signed an annual maintenance contract for our unit
As always Florencio Perez with Milestone dud a great job.  He showed the damaged items to us and explained everything that we should and needed to know.  Thank you

Tyler is very knowledgeable. He diagnosed the problem with my air conditioner drain line. Once he determined the problem he recommended a solution. An expensive solution but the work had to be done.  And he did great job of clearing my drain line.
Mason was phenomenal! He will definitely be requested in the future if we need anything done!
Justyn C was great! Respectful and finished the work order in timely fashion. Broke down the options I have for further maintenance and also very friendly with my doggo
Tech was quick and precise confident and courteous spoke very well in lamens terms and made the whole process easy and efficient service I have come to expect from Milestone every time

Milestone came out to clean my air ducts. Our wires got crossed in the scheduling so they arrived while I wasn't home but were kind enough to wait the 5 minutes or so it took for me to race home. They were able to get the job completed in a little over 2 hours and were so professional they even moved the machine to outside so it wouldn't interrupt my husband's work call. Great service and I appreciate the flexibility and professionalism.

Brandon was punctual, knowledgeable, efficient and overall great. My family suffered in the heat for hours and in a matter of minutes we were looking for throw blankets to keep warm. Thank you for your service.
Trevor did a great job of checking my plumbing throughout my house and pricing out a list of repairs. No pressure sales!  And the service call charge was easy to swallow.
What appeared to be a terrible problem was diagnosed and repaired easily and quickly. Our technician waked us through all foreseeable steps prior to starting work. There were no surprises.

Dustin did an outstanding job installing a light in the rear of my home.  He provided me with the best options to ensure that the light served my purpose.  He was extremely patient, professional and personable.  Dustin answered all of my questions, and made sure that I was completely satisfied with the job.  I would request him again if I needed another electrical job done at my home.

Just left without calling to confirm with me. I was on the way and found that he already left. We waited the whole day and they could not wait 5 min or confirm. The time was given 30-45 before they arrive and he just came and left.

Update on the same:

So they again quickly scheduled back within an hour which I appreciate. Same person came by. Service and courtesy wise good and professional but price wise way too expensive. I was quoted for $137 but end up paying $467 and most of it was for ins
